subject: Linguistics
title: What Is Sociolinguistics
description: A quick win: understand What Is Sociolinguistics.

hook.text: You speak differently to your boss than to your best friend—and you switch without thinking.

buildup.text: Sociolinguistics studies how language varies and changes in relation to social factors.

discovery.text: It examines how class, gender, ethnicity, and age shape how people speak.

twist.text: There's no 'correct' dialect—every variety follows its own systematic rules.

climax.text: Sociolinguistics bridges language and society, revealing patterns invisible to casual listeners.

punchline.text: How you talk says as much about you as what you talk about.

quiz.question: What does sociolinguistics study?
options: How language relates to social factors
